doc: Certain executables distributed with the MySQL database management system do not have specific man pages.

In most cases, you can run the executable from the command line with a "--help" argument to display a brief summary of the executable's arguments and function. For more information about MySQL, please refer to the MySQL reference manual, which may already be installed locally and which is also available online at http://dev.mysql.com/doc/mysql/en
Please refer to http://bugs.mysql.com/ to report bugs.
